title: A Common Pool of Privacy Problems: Legal and Technical Lessons from a Large-Scale Web-Scraped Machine Learning Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the average pixel brightness of facial images successfully detected and blurred versus those left undetected by the SCRFD face detection algorithm to assess potential demographic disparities.
Using Amazon Rekognition to estimate and compare the average age of faces successfully detected versus those missed by the SCRFD face obfuscation algorithm.
Using Amazon Rekognition to classify gender and comparing the proportion of faces predicted as female between images successfully detected versus those missed by the SCRFD face obfuscation algorithm.
